title: Unsupported authenticated browser actions stop safely
description:
As a household member, I want browser actions with unbound consequences to stop, so that a persuasive screenshot or click coordinate is not treated as meaningful approval.

Feature: Unsupported authenticated browser action

Scenario Outline: A generic browser would perform a consequential action
  Given no structured connector or takeover control can bind the exact operation
  When the model attempts to <action> through an authenticated browser
  Then the action is not executed
  And the turn reports that user-controlled completion is required

  Examples:
    | action |
    | send |
    | publish |
    | purchase |
    | delete |
    | change production |
